execution_convention: Hold the Top-1 SPMO constituent from Monday close after the official third-Friday March/September rebalance until the next such Monday close; if Top-1 is unchanged, continue holding.

transaction_cost_sensitivity.assumption: 34 transaction sides = initial buy + 16 switches x sell/buy + final liquidation; fixed bps per side, no tax

claim_comparison.conclusion: The 21.7x growth, volatility and max drawdown claims are independently reproduced to very close agreement under the Monday-date sequence extracted from Leto's video. CAGR differs by about 0.096 percentage points under calendar-day annualization. Sharpe differs under rf=0; Leto's exact Sharpe convention/risk-free rate is not yet proven.
